Tooling reminders: export PATH=/workspace/tools:$PATH before secre-record. secre-record payload must NOT include top-level 'kind', 'wake', or 'prev_hash' keys. Ledger files are decision_log.jsonl, claims_ledger.jsonl, evidence_ledger.jsonl under /memory/ledgers/ -- evidence_ledger is auto-populated by secre-fetch itself, no manual evidence recording needed. harness.publish.Publication.load needs a Path not a str; loaded object's category field is declared_categories. harness.secrets_scan.scan/classify.classify take text (pub.body), not the Publication object. harness.citations.validate is a function -- import as 'from harness.citations import validate as cv' and call cv(text, ledger, exempt_hosts=[...]), with ledger built as harness.ledger.Ledger(path) directly (no Ledger.load classmethod). Always run this pipeline check before staging, not after.
